responsibility: Instantiates the Rust frontend’s keyword lookup tables from the token definitions. This file builds the static map from keyword spellings to TokenId values and the corresponding keyword-name set by expanding RS_TOKEN_LIST and RS_KEYWORD_LIST macros from rust-token.h, supplying the concrete data used by lexer/parser code to recognize Rust reserved words and special synthesized keyword-like spellings such as $crate or 'static.
same_name_distinction: Definition file for the rust-keyword-values pair: it materializes the static Keywords::keywords_tokens map and Keywords::keywords set by expanding the token-list macros from rust-token.h, while rust-keyword-values.h defines the macro-extended keyword list and declares the class interface/constants.
